 MSBSHSE has shared the tentative dates for the SSC Class 10 and HSC Class 12 board examinations 2027. The SSC written examinations will be held from February 15 to March 11, 2027, and the HSC written examinations will be held from February 8 to March 16, 2027.
 The Maharashtra Board has also extended the deadline for HSC and SSC exam form submission 2027 to November 30, 2026. Schools and junior colleges must deposit exam fees by December 7.
 Students can check the Maharashtra Board SSC HSC Time Table 2027 on the official website, mahahsscboard, once the MSBSHSE Class 10 and 12 subject-wise date sheet PDF is announced.

 Maharashtra Board SSC HSC Time Table 2027: Steps to download
 Follow the steps below to download the Maharashtra SSC and HSC 2027 subject-wise examination schedule.
 Visit the official website, mahahsscboard.in
 On the homepage, check the latest notifications or the examination section
 Click on the ‘Maharashtra SSC or HSC timetable 2027’ link
 Open the date sheet PDF and check the subject-wise dates
 Download and save the PDF for future reference
 Students have to visit the MSBSHSE website for updates or changes to the examination schedule.
